dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: I heard you made it back from the Night Kingdom!

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: Very impressive. Considering your courage, conviction, and strength... I'd say you're the most outstanding warriors I've ever met. If only I could be more like you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We saw Mallko in the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You recount what you saw in the Night Kingdom to Vichama.

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: So that's what happened... Mallko, he chose to...

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. It's hard to express what I'm feeling right now. Even though we're separated by death, we still managed to accomplish something together... It's like we had the chance to fight side by side again.

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep, now. Mallko, my friend... just keep waiting. We'll be together again one day.
